"Why have you left me to rot in the cells of {ArrestingHouse}? This is not a life worthy of a noble{man(ArrestedCharacter)}!

I just can't do this anymore..."

"Surely you and {currentHeadOf(ArrestingHouse)} should've been able to negotiate my release by now. Please, talk to {him(currentHeadOf(ArrestingHouse))} and resolve this mishap. This is not how I should be spending my days..."

{ArrestedCharacter} is having a tough time as a prisoner of {ArrestingHouse}.

{He(ArrestedCharacter)} has been stuck in {Location} for a long time. Perhaps it is time to negotiate {his(ArrestedCharacter)} release?
"Escaping the cell was hard, but disguising myself as a commoner to board a transport shuttle was one of the worst experiences of my life..."
{His(ArrestedCharacter)} health seems to have declined. Perhaps {ArrestingHouse} didn't want the death of an invalid on their hands.
